input: City officials announced on Monday that the downtown library will reopen next month after a two-year renovation. The project added a children's wing, study rooms, and solar panels. Officials said the building will use forty percent less energy.
gold: The downtown library reopens next month after a two-year renovation that added a children's wing, study rooms, and solar panels.

input: Researchers tested a new tutoring app with three hundred high school students over one semester. Students who used it three times a week improved their algebra scores by twelve percent compared with a control group. The team plans a larger trial next year.
gold: A tutoring app raised algebra scores twelve percent for students using it three times a week; a larger trial is planned.

input: A storm knocked out power to about fifty thousand homes overnight. Crews restored service to most customers by noon, but some rural areas may stay dark until Wednesday.
gold: An overnight storm cut power to fifty thousand homes; most were restored by noon, rural areas may wait until Wednesday.
